Distribution. South Russia (Volgograd and Orenburg Prov.), Kazakhstan, Caucasus and Transcaucasia, Asia Minor, Central Asia (deserts and semideserts), South Siberia and Mongolia. Variability. There are four species group taxa described within this species: rada Boisduval, 1848, altivaga Alphéraky, 1894, schlumbergeri Fuchs, 1903, sibirica Kozhantshikov, 1924. The status of only two of them is valid: nominate and altivaga.
